_comment: Bundled presets. Each needs an author and a licence; community builds may only be added with the author's permission under a licence that allows redistribution. 'order' is the learning order as [talent spellID, ranks to reach]; it doubles as the leveling path. build_data.py checks every preset against the tree (tiers, prerequisites, 51 points) and writes Data/Presets.lua.

presets.name: Arms Mortal Strike (two-hander)
presets.author: Build Atlas
presets.why: Everything in Arms makes your two-hander's big hits bigger and more frequent. Improved Overpower, Impale and Deep Wounds turn crits into extra damage, Cruelty in Fury adds those crits, and Anger Management plus Unbridled Wrath keep Rage flowing for Mortal Strike.
play: Keep Rend on targets that live long enough: Bloodthrill can then enable Overpower.
Use Mortal Strike on cooldown; fill with Overpower when it lights up and Heroic Strike when Rage is high.
Stance-dance into Battle Stance for Overpower: Improved Tactical Mastery keeps your Rage.
Use Sweeping Strikes before Whirlwind or Mortal Strike when two enemies are close.

presets.name: Fury dual wield
presets.author: Build Atlas
presets.why: Two fast weapons mean many swings: Cruelty adds crits, crits trigger Flurry for even more swings, and every hit can add Rage through Unbridled Wrath. Dual Wield Specialization and Furious Precision fix the off-hand's weaknesses, and Bloodthirst is the main spender.
play: Bloodthirst on cooldown, then Whirlwind; Heroic Strike only when Rage is above about 50.
Use Death Wish together with your other cooldowns at the start of a fight.
Keep Battle Shout up; Booming Voice makes it cheaper and wider.
Hit chance matters more than usual: missed off-hand swings lose Flurry and Rage.

presets.name: Protection shield tank
presets.author: Build Atlas
presets.why: Blocks, dodges and parries all feed Rage (Shield Specialization, Master of Defense), Rage pays for Shield Slam and Revenge, and Defiance plus Focused Rage make every point count for threat. Bastion and Shield Slam turn the shield into your main weapon.
play: Open with Shield Slam, keep Sunder Armor stacking, and use Revenge whenever it is available.
Keep Shield Block up against hard hitters: more blocks mean more Rage and Revenge.
Save Shield Wall and Last Stand for emergencies.
Thunder Clap and Demoralizing Shout on packs; Improved Thunder Clap makes it cheap.
